/* - useReducer() Hook is similar to useState(), But instead of providing state & setter function. It provides state and dispatch function. - useReducer() Hook accepts 2 arguments: 1. Reducer function - specifies how the state get updated 2. Initil State And returns: Current State and Dispatch Method */ import { useState } from "react" export default function UseReducerPage() { const [counter, setCounter] = useState(0) return (

Counter: {counter}

) }
